purpose: Define grouped vertical-bar participation rules for expressions with more than two participants.
core_problem: Binary closure of A|B does not automatically define closure for A|B|C or nested expressions such as (A|B)|C and A|(B|C).

definition.name: Grouped Admissible Participation Closure
definition.reading: A grouped bar expression denotes a structured participation field in which multiple admissible operands co-participate through ordered interfaces.

group_operand_rules.operand_requirement: Every participant A_i must satisfy Typed_a(A_i) or be explicitly marked as pending admissibility qualification.
group_operand_rules.interface_requirement: Every adjacent or declared interface A_i | A_j must be legally evaluable under D or a registered successor evaluator.
invalid_group_conditions: grouping is changed without proving admissible regrouping
order is ignored without proving admissible permutation
projection-only analogy is used as group equivalence

group_closure_candidate.definition: A grouped bar expression is admissibly closed when all typed participants and declared interfaces satisfy local bar admissibility and the whole grouping preserves orientation-consistent participation structure.
group_closure_candidate.candidate_formula: Adm_|^G(A_1,...,A_n; G) := [∀A_i Typed_a(A_i)] ∧ [∀e_ij ∈ E(G), Adm_|(A_i,A_j)] ∧ Preserve_O(G) ∧ Eval_D^G(G) ∧ D_G(G) > epsilon_a
notes: G denotes the declared participation graph or grouping structure.
E(G) denotes the required bar interfaces inside the group.
Preserve_O(G) is a placeholder until Orientation Space O is formally closed.
D_G is a grouped distinction evaluator, not assumed identical to binary D.

associativity_rules.statement: (A|B)|C is not automatically equivalent to A|(B|C).
associativity_rules.allowed_equivalence: Associative regrouping is legal only under an explicit admissible regrouping proof.
associativity_rules.regrouping_placeholder: Assoc_|(A,B,C) := condition under which (A|B)|C iff_R A|(B|C)
associativity_rules.forbidden_assumption: Do not flatten grouped bar expressions into unordered lists.

permutation_rules.statement: A|B|C is not automatically equivalent to B|A|C, A|C|B, or any other permutation.
permutation_rules.allowed_equivalence: Permutation is legal only under explicit admissible orientation-preserving equivalence.
permutation_rules.permutation_placeholder: Perm_|(G,G') := condition under which G iff_R G'
permutation_rules.forbidden_assumption: Do not treat participant order as cosmetic.

triadic_closure_rules.reason: The framework repeatedly uses triadic structures, including Law|Operator|Truth and RT/QM_app/GR_app patterns.
triadic_closure_rules.triadic_reading: A triadic bar expression is a three-part participation field where the middle term may function as mediator, operator, comparison interface, or co-generator depending on typed role.
triadic_closure_rules.role_requirement: Triadic expressions must declare whether the middle participant is ordinary participant, mediator, operator, or core condition.

relationship_to_orientation.statement: Grouped closure requires orientation preservation, but Orientation Space O is not yet formally closed.
relationship_to_orientation.interim_rule: Do not mark grouped closure final until Preserve_O(G) is formally defined.

relationship_to_Org_a.statement: Org_a axioms may now cite grouped bar closure as a prerequisite, but Org_a remains open until Orientation Space O is defined.
relationship_to_Org_a.candidate_dependency: Org_a({D(A_i|B_i)>epsilon_a}) requires Adm_|^G over the organized participation field.

relationship_to_Sigma_D.statement: Sigma_D equivalence must preserve grouped participation structure, not merely pairwise binary admissibility.

registry_updates_required.action: Update vertical_bar_operator group_closure_status from OPEN to DEFINITION_CANDIDATE
Register grouped_bar_closure as formal definition candidate or nested property of vertical_bar_operator
Move grouped_bar_closure from implicit/open to GAP_DEFINITION_CANDIDATE

textbook_patch_required.target_section: Chapter 14 Stage 0 subsection or primitive operator appendix
textbook_patch_required.insert_title: Grouped Bar Closure and Triadic Participation
must_state: Binary bar closure does not automatically imply grouped closure.
Grouped expressions are not automatically associative.
Grouped expressions are not automatically permutable.
Triadic expressions are first-class participation fields.
Orientation preservation remains an explicit dependency.

validation_requirements: No downstream bridge may be marked closed by this patch alone.
Org_a remains blocked pending orientation definition.
forbidden_claims: A|B|C is merely shorthand for pairwise A|B and B|C
bar grouping is associative by default
bar grouping is commutative by default
triads are reducible to binary pairs without loss
grouped bar closure fully defines Org_a

recommended_next_patch.goal: Define Orientation Space O as the admissible space of participation directions governing bar expressions, Org_a preservation, and knot-class selection.
